answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital, creating a ferrous barrier against network fragmentation. An attacker must expend significant value to cultivate a trellis of illicit identities, yet the protocol remains secure. By anchoring truth to a verifiable beacon of staked assets, the system forces adversaries to absorb the prohibitive opportunity costs of liquidity lockup, rendering unauthorized expansion economically irrational.
